## Automated Tests Required

### 12-2 Challenge-Selection Screen — UI + Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/challenge/challenge_selection_screen_test.gd`
**GDD/spec source**: `design/ux/challenge-selection-screen.md` (Acceptance Criteria section, 9 items)

**What to test**:
- Screen appears immediately on `era_transitioned`, before any other era-start logic (Rule 1)
- 0 challenges selected + Confirm → `combined_meta_multiplier = 1.0`, transition to `action_screen.tscn` behaves identically to a non-zero selection
- 2 challenges selected (multiplier 2.0 and 2.5) → `CombinedMultiplierLabel` shows `5.0` immediately on the second toggle, no delay
- 3/3 already selected, 4th toggle attempted → rejected, tooltip explains why
- Back-gesture (Android) / Esc (Web) on this screen → always ignored, Confirm is the only exit
- `MetaBonusGrantedLabel` shows the exact value the Wypalenie card previously previewed via `compute_next_grant()` (ADR-0017) — same number, not an approximation
- No active path at previous era's end → `MetaBonusGrantedLabel` shows "Brak bonusu tej ery", never blank or a misleading `0%`

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Zero challenges selected (boundary — must not be treated as an error state)
- Exactly 3 selected (the cap) — 4th attempt rejected without side effects
- Previous era ended with no active Class Path (zero-grant path per the locked GDD rule)

**Estimated test count**: ~7 integration tests

**Manual verification** (Visual/Feel + accessibility, not automatable):
- [ ] All interactive elements (toggle, Confirm) have touch targets ≥44×44dp
- [ ] Text contrast ≥4.5:1
- [ ] Screen transition reads clearly, no jank
- Sign-off: `ux-designer` or `art-director`, evidence via screenshot to `production/qa/evidence/`

### 12-6 Card Wave 2 — Config/Data
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/card_content_database/card_wave_2_content_lint_test.gd`
**GDD/spec source**: `design/gdd/card-content-database.md` (Acceptance Criteria section — schema rules apply identically to new cards)

**What to test** (reuse the exact schema contract already locked for the 12 MVP cards):
- Every new card has exactly 2 `options`
- `id`, `trigger_condition`, `text`, `options` all present and non-empty; no `id` collides with any of the existing 17 cards
- `resource_deltas` present as `Dict[str,int]` on every option (empty dict valid, missing field is not)
- Risky/safe pairs: exactly one option increments `risky_choices_count`, the other `safe_choices_count` — never both, never neither
- Neutral cards: `counter_increments` absent/empty on both options, `resource_deltas` non-empty on at least one
- Risky/safe Zasięgi delta ratio stays within the locked `risky_safe_zasiegi_ratio` band (1.4x–1.8x, per registry)
- New `path_tags` field (per Sprint 11 scope — this field didn't exist on the original 12 cards) is present and confirmed against the locked Class Path display names (`class-path-display-names.md` memory) before merge — **do not guess path_tags without user confirmation**

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Milestone-bearing new cards (if any) — same one-option-only `milestone_to_set` rule as `staged_drama`/`cancel_threat`/`algorithm_hack`
- Sponsors-qualifying new cards (if any) — same restriction (`Sponsorzy` key only on options explicitly designed as sponsor-qualifying)

**Estimated test count**: ~6 content-lint tests (table-wide, not per-card)

**Manual verification**:
- [ ] `path_tags` values confirmed with user before merge (per project memory — best-fit tags need explicit sign-off, not assumed)
- [ ] English-only player-facing text (per the Sprint 9 PL→EN audit precedent)

### 12-3 — Playtest Full Era Loop
**Verification method**: Playtest session, structured notes
**Who must sign off**: solo dev + qa-lead review of notes
**Evidence to capture**: session write-up in `production/playtests/`, using `production/playtests/playtest-question-guide.md`

Checklist:
- [ ] Full loop played: initial actions → decision cards → Cringe sustained to 100 → Wypalenie card → era reset → meta-bonus applied → challenge selection (12-2 must ship first) → new era begins
- [ ] Player experience notes cover: does the reset feel like a real stake (not just a number reset)? Does the satire read as intended (Pillar 3)? Any confusion points in the first 2 minutes of the NEW era specifically (not just first-ever session)?
- [ ] Explicitly logged as N=1 — flag in the write-up that 2+ additional sessions are recommended before treating "core fantasy lands" as confirmed

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify before QA hand-off for this sprint:

1. Game launches to main menu without crash
2. New game can be started
3. **Challenge-selection screen appears correctly on era transition** (new this sprint — highest regression risk, first UI ever built on top of `ChallengeSystem`)
4. Full era loop end-to-end: action → card → burnout → reset → challenge selection → new era (regression risk: this is the first time the loop is exercised as one continuous player-facing path)
5. Save/load cycle completes without data loss across an era transition (existing coverage via `prestige_atomicity_test`, `burnout_persistence_test` — re-verify manually once, since this is the first UI-driven trigger of the path rather than a test-harness-driven one)
6. Performance: no new frame spikes introduced by the challenge-selection screen (informal check only — no device for a real budget check this sprint)

## Definition of Done — This Sprint

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — via automated test result OR documented manual evidence
- [ ] Test file exists at the specified path for 12-2 (Integration) and 12-6 (Config/Data)
- [ ] Manual evidence document exists for 12-2's accessibility/visual checks
- [ ] Smoke check passes (`/smoke-check sprint`) before QA hand-off
- [ ] No regressions introduced (full suite green per 12-1)
- [ ] Code reviewed
- [ ] Story file updated to `Status: Complete` (via `/story-done`)
- [ ] `/gate-check production` re-run returns PASS
